payload.label: Find action moments in a video
payload.job: Find where the action happens in a video, such as the moment a ball is hit, and give each moment's time in seconds
payload.description: Ranks the moments where a sharp sound meets movement in the picture (a racket meeting a ball, a clap, a landing) and returns their times in the video's own seconds, strongest first. Search the whole video or only a stretch of it.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

from.description: Start of the stretch to search (default 0)

to.description: End of the stretch to search (default the end)

payload.label: Find scene changes in a video
payload.job: Find the times where a video cuts from one shot to another
payload.description: Returns every time (seconds) where the picture changes to a new shot. A higher threshold (0 to 1) finds fewer, harder cuts.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

threshold.description: How different two frames must be to count as a cut (default 0.3)

payload.label: Find the quiet parts of a video
payload.job: Find the silent stretches in a video or recording and the parts worth keeping between them
payload.description: Returns the silent stretches and the spoken or sounding stretches to keep between them, in seconds, so pauses can be cut out.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

threshold_db.description: Quieter than this counts as silence (default -30)

pad_seconds.description: Sound kept around each kept stretch (default 0.05)

payload.label: Find the beats in music
payload.job: Find the beat times in a song or in a video's soundtrack, to cut on the beat
payload.description: Returns the time of each beat (seconds) and the tempo in beats per minute.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

payload.label: Reframe a video to a new shape
payload.job: Make a video vertical, square or any other shape, with the frame following the person or action
payload.description: Crops the whole video to a new shape (9:16 for a reel by default) with the window following what moves in the picture, and saves the new video in your files.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

fill.description: crop (default) fills the frame; blur fits the whole picture over a blurred copy; a colour such as black fits it over that colour

width.description: Output width in pixels (with height); default the largest that fits without enlarging

payload.label: Change speed over part of a video
payload.job: Play part of a video in slow motion or sped up, such as the moment of contact at half speed, and optionally keep only a window around it
payload.description: Plays the stretch from `from` to `to` (seconds) at `speed` (0.5 is half speed) with the sound, the rest at normal speed, keeping only `keep_from` to `keep_to` when given. Saves the new video in your files.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

from.description: Start of the stretch to change

to.description: End of the stretch to change

keep_from.description: Keep the video from here (default the start)

keep_to.description: Keep the video up to here (default the end)

payload.label: Add captions to a video from its transcript
payload.job: Burn captions into a video from its transcript, in a caption style: plain subtitles, large captions, or words that light up as they are said
payload.description: Takes timed words (the speech-to-text tool's output, or a list of {text, start, end}) and burns captions into the whole video in the style you name (see style), words gathered into short lines the way that style reads best. Saves the new video in your files.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

transcript.description: Timed words: {words:[{text,start,end}]}, {segments:[{words}]} or a list of words

transcript_from.description: Where in the video the transcript's zero is (default 0)

anyOf.description: Your own caption look, starting from the style named by id and changing any of its fields

size.description: Text size in pixels on a frame whose shorter side is 1080

shadow.description: Pixels on a frame whose shorter side is 1080: x, y is the offset; blur and spread make a soft halo; colour #rrggbb; opacity 0 to 1; null for no shadow

colours.description: #rrggbb: spoken is a word being said (and every word of a line shown whole), upcoming the words still to come, outline the edge

position.description: Where a caption's bottom-centre sits, as fractions of the frame from the left and the top

reveal.description: line shows each line whole; karaoke lights each word up as it is said

casing.description: How words are written whatever case they were heard in: a capital at each sentence's start, and words always written with a capital

grouping.description: How spoken words are gathered into caption lines

style.description: The caption style (default subtitles): subtitles (Subtitles); emphasis (Large captions); spoken-words (Highlight spoken words); serif-spoken-words (Serif spoken words); white-words-light-up (White words light up). Or an object with id set to one of them and any of font, size, bold, italic, outline, shadow, colours, position, reveal, grouping changed.

payload.label: Cut a clip and caption it
payload.job: Cut one stretch out of a video and burn in its spoken words as captions
payload.description: Keeps `from` to `to` (seconds) of the video and burns the words spoken in it as captions in the style you name (see style), for example words that light up as they are said. Without a transcript it only cuts. Saves the clip in your files.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

transcript.description: Timed words for the whole video or for the clip

transcript_from.description: Where in the video the transcript's zero is: 0 for the whole video, the clip's start for the clip's own words

anyOf.description: Your own caption look, starting from the style named by id and changing any of its fields

size.description: Text size in pixels on a frame whose shorter side is 1080

shadow.description: Pixels on a frame whose shorter side is 1080: x, y is the offset; blur and spread make a soft halo; colour #rrggbb; opacity 0 to 1; null for no shadow

colours.description: #rrggbb: spoken is a word being said (and every word of a line shown whole), upcoming the words still to come, outline the edge

position.description: Where a caption's bottom-centre sits, as fractions of the frame from the left and the top

reveal.description: line shows each line whole; karaoke lights each word up as it is said

casing.description: How words are written whatever case they were heard in: a capital at each sentence's start, and words always written with a capital

grouping.description: How spoken words are gathered into caption lines

style.description: The caption style (default subtitles): subtitles (Subtitles); emphasis (Large captions); spoken-words (Highlight spoken words); serif-spoken-words (Serif spoken words); white-words-light-up (White words light up). Or an object with id set to one of them and any of font, size, bold, italic, outline, shadow, colours, position, reveal, grouping changed.

payload.label: Arrange videos side by side
payload.job: Put two or more videos side by side, stacked, or in a grid in one frame, such as a swing next to a pro's
payload.description: Plays the videos together in one frame: side by side (h), stacked (v) or a grid, with their sound mixed. Saves the new video in your files.

videos.description: The videos' identities in your files

layout.description: h side by side (default), v stacked, grid

seconds.description: How long to play (default the videos' own length)

payload.label: Render an edit

screen.label: Video editor
screen.about: Cut, arrange and export a video.

payload.job: Render a video from an edit decision list: cuts, speed changes, reframing, captions, music and layouts of your files
payload.description: Renders one edit in the media-composition edit format (spine.segments of clips with in, out, speed, speed_ramp, reframe, crop, fades; split layouts; subtitles.ass; audio_graph.music_bed; encode width and height). Every source is a file identity from your files. Saves the video in your files.

edl.description: The edit itself, written here as JSON: nothing needs saving first. Wherever a source goes (a clip's source, a music bed, a subtitles file), give that file's identity (1f: then 64 hex) from find_file, list_files or write_file.

payload.label: Measure a video's loudness
payload.job: Measure how loud a video or recording is and whether it is ready to publish
payload.description: Measures integrated loudness (LUFS), loudness range and true peak, and says whether it meets the target (-14 LUFS by default) without clipping.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

payload.label: Pick a cover frame for a video
payload.job: Choose the best frame of a video for its cover or thumbnail and save it as a picture
payload.description: Scores frames across the video for sharpness and exposure, saves the best one (or the frame at `at` seconds) as a JPEG in your files, and returns its time.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

at.description: Use the frame at this time instead of choosing

width.description: Picture width in pixels (default the video's)

payload.label: Export an editor timeline
payload.job: Export an edit as a timeline file (Final Cut Pro XML) that Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut can open
payload.description: Writes the edit (the same format render-an-edit takes, with encode width, height and fps) as an xmeml timeline naming each source by the path it has on the editor's computer, saves it in your files, and says what the file could not carry.

edl.description: The edit; each source is the absolute path the editor will find it at

source_metadata.description: Per source path: fps, duration, width, height, has_audio

payload.label: Extract the sound from a video
payload.job: Take the sound out of a video as a small audio file, for example to transcribe it
payload.description: Saves the video's sound as a mono 16 kHz MP3 in your files (about 0.5 MB a minute), small enough for the speech-to-text tool.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

provenance.source: ffmpeg in the Workshop's container image

payload.label: Find recurring voices
payload.job: Group recurring voices across audio and video files, keep stable voice clusters, and show which files contain the same speaker
payload.description: Uses a public CAM++ speaker model on speech windows from your selected files. Returns candidate voice groups and their time spans, keeps cluster embeddings in your account for later files, and shows a person's name only when a name was explicitly attached.

files.description: One to twenty audio or video file identities from your Files

max_seconds_per_file.description: Maximum seconds to inspect in each file (default 1800)

minimum_similarity.description: Cosine similarity required to reuse a voice cluster (default 0.72)

known_voices.description: Existing voice clusters from your account; filled automatically

person_bindings.description: Names explicitly attached to voice clusters; filled automatically

provenance.model: 3D-Speaker CAM++ 200k ONNX, Apache 2.0, pinned model revision

payload.label: Blur and silence everyone who has not agreed to be filmed
payload.job: Make a copy of a video with every face blurred and every word silenced except those of the people who agreed to be filmed, before it is posted or shared
payload.description: Give video, a video in the person's files, and agreed, pictures of each person who agreed to be filmed (a clear picture of their face; the person themself included). Every face in every frame is found; a face that matches someone who agreed stays as it is, and every other face, including one it cannot be sure of, is blurred past recognition. Give agreed_voices too, a recording of each of them speaking, and every word said by anyone else is silenced, judged half a second at a time; without it the sound is copied unchanged. The original video is never changed. The copy is kept in the person's files under Made by tools, named by name when given. Returns how many faces were seen, blurred and kept, how much speech was silenced, and any agreed picture in which no face was found. Faces are found with YuNet and recognized with SFace (OpenCV Zoo) and voices told apart with CAM++, on the tool's own computer; nothing leaves it.

video.description: The video, by its identity in your files

agreed.description: Pictures of each person who agreed to be filmed, by identity in your files; with none, every face is blurred

agreed_voices.description: Recordings of each person who agreed speaking (ten seconds or more each); every word by anyone else is silenced, and with none, every word is

voice_match.description: How alike speech must be to an agreed voice to be kept (default 0.5); higher silences more

match.description: How alike a face must be to an agreed picture to be kept (default 0.363); higher blurs more

name.description: What to call the copy, like Serve practice without strangers
name.x-free-text-because: What to call the blurred copy this run makes: the name of the new file itself.

provenance.model: YuNet face detection 2023mar (MIT) and SFace face recognition 2021dec (Apache 2.0), OpenCV Zoo, and 3D-Speaker CAM++ 200k (Apache 2.0), pinned revisions

payload.label: Name a voice
payload.job: Attach a person's name to one voice cluster after identifying that voice
payload.description: Keeps your explicit person name for an existing voice cluster. Later analysis shows that name on matching voice segments; the model itself never guesses a name.

voice_id.description: A voice_id returned by Find recurring voices

payload.label: Mix sounds under a video
payload.job: Lay music, voice-overs and sound effects under a video at chosen times, each trimmed, with its own volume and fades, music lowering itself under speech
payload.description: Plays each sound from `start` seconds into the video, trimmed to `from`..`to` of its file, at its volume with fades; a sound with duck drops while the video's speech or a voice-over is heard. Optionally evens out the whole video's loudness (loudness_lufs, -14 suits most sites). Saves the new video in your files.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

file.description: The sound's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex): music, a voice-over or a sound effect

label.description: Your own name for it, like Music or Door slam

start.description: Seconds into the video where it starts playing

from.description: Where in the sound file to start (default 0)

to.description: Where in the sound file to stop (default its end; it also stops when the video ends)

volume.description: 1 is as recorded (default 1); 0.3 suits music under speech

duck.description: Lower it automatically while the video's own speech, or any sound that does not duck, is heard

sounds.description: The sounds to lay under the video

loudness_lufs.description: Even out the finished video's loudness to this level (-14 suits most sites)

screen.label: Mix sounds
screen.about: Lays music and sounds under a video.

payload.label: Lay pictures over a video
payload.job: Put a logo, a photo, or a picture-in-picture or b-roll video over a video at chosen times, with position, size and opacity
payload.description: Draws each picture or video from `start` seconds for its length, `size` wide, its centre at `x`,`y` (0..1 across and down), at its opacity, later ones over earlier ones; a video plays its `from`..`to` stretch. Saves the new video in your files.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

file.description: The picture's or video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex): a logo, a photo or b-roll

label.description: Your own name for it, like Logo

kind.description: image for a still, video for a moving clip (read from the file when left out)

start.description: Seconds into the video where it appears

from.description: For a video: where in it to start playing (default 0)

to.description: For a video: where in it to stop; for a still, from plus how many seconds it shows (default: a still stays to the end, a video plays its own length)

x.description: Where its centre sits across the frame: 0 left edge, 0.5 middle, 1 right edge (default 0.5)

y.description: Where its centre sits down the frame: 0 top edge, 0.5 middle, 1 bottom edge (default 0.5)

size.description: Its width as a share of the frame's width, 1 fills the width (default 0.3)

pictures.description: The pictures and videos to lay over it, back to front

screen.label: Layer pictures
screen.about: Lays pictures and clips over a video.

payload.label: Point editor projects at clips' new places
payload.job: On the person's own computer, point their Premiere Pro projects and DaVinci Resolve's open project at clips that moved to a new place, such as their Trillion files connected as a drive
payload.description: Runs on the computer where the editors are. Rewrites each Premiere Pro project that names a moved clip so it opens the clip from its new place, keeping the original project beside it, and relinks the clips in the project DaVinci Resolve has open through Resolve's own scripting. A project that is open is left alone and reported. On a computer every Premiere project is found by Spotlight; elsewhere name the project files.

moves.description: Each moved clip or folder: its old full path and its new full path

projects.description: The Premiere project files to check; left out on a computer, every one Spotlight finds

screen.label: Fix moved clips
screen.about: Points your Premiere projects at clips you moved.

payload.label: Change a video's colour
payload.job: Put a colour look or grade on a video and adjust its brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, warmth or vibrance
payload.description: Applies named looks (film grades, camera log to normal colour, VHS, golden hour, film grain and more) and colour adjustments to the whole video, optionally matching its colour to another video first, and saves the new video in your files at its own size and length.

video.description: The video's identity in your files (1f: then 64 hex), as find_file or list_files returns it

looks.description: Looks to put on the video, applied in this order: vhs (VHS tape); dreamy-bloom (Dreamy glow); crt (Old TV screen); cinematic-bloom (Cinematic glow); golden-hour (Golden hour); log-to-normal (Camera log to normal colour); clean-base (Clean base); punchy-curves (Punchy curves); richer-oranges (Richer oranges); oranges-toward-red (Oranges toward red); brighter-colour (More colour in bright areas); teal-and-orange (Teal and orange); warm-oranges (Warm oranges); warm-film (Warm film grade); warm-film-textured (Warm film grade with texture); widescreen-bars (Widescreen bars); soft-corners (Soft dark corners); colour-fringe (Colour fringe); film-grain (Film grain); soft-glow (Soft glow)

match_to.description: Another video in your files whose colour this one should match (its identity, 1f: then 64 hex)

match_at.description: Seconds into match_to to take its colour from (default 0)
